---
title: "Outbreak Situation Report"
org: "Federal Ministry of Health (SAMPLE)"
outbreak: "Cholera"
sitrep-no: "7"
period: "7 Sep – 14 Nov 2026"
country: "Sampleland"
prepared-by: "Prepared by the Epidemiology Unit · SIMULATED DATA for demonstration"
format:
  typst:
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ
      - typst-show.typ
    fig-format: png
    fig-dpi: 220
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  linelist: "data/linelist.csv"
  population: "data/population.csv"
---

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

ll  <- read.csv(params$linelist, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pop <- read.csv(params$population)
ll$onset_date <- as.Date(ll$onset_date)

brand  <- "#0B5D7A"
accent <- "#C8442B"
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = brand),
        legend.position = "top"))

total   <- nrow(ll)
deaths  <- sum(ll$outcome == "Died")
cfr     <- deaths / total * 100
conf    <- sum(ll$status == "Confirmed")
last_wk <- max(ll$onset_date) - 6
cases_last7 <- sum(ll$onset_date >= last_wk)
cases_prev7 <- sum(ll$onset_date >= last_wk - 7 & ll$onset_date < last_wk)
change  <- (cases_last7 - cases_prev7) / cases_prev7 * 100
n_states <- n_distinct(ll$state)

by_state <- ll |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(cases = n(), confirmed = sum(status == "Confirmed"),
            deaths = sum(outcome == "Died"), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(pop, by = "state") |>
  mutate(cfr = deaths / cases * 100,
         ar  = cases / population * 100000) |>
  arrange(desc(cases))
top_state <- by_state$state[1]
hi_cfr    <- by_state |> filter(cases >= 10) |> slice_max(cfr, n = 1)
```

```{r kpis}
#| output: asis
kpi <- function(v, l, col = "brand") sprintf('[#kpi("%s", "%s", color: %s)]', v, l, col)
cat("```{=typst}\n#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr), gutter: 8pt,\n",
    kpi(format(total, big.mark = ","), "Total cases"), ",\n",
    kpi(deaths, "Deaths", "accent"), ",\n",
    kpi(sprintf("%.1f%%", cfr), "Case fatality ratio", "accent"), ",\n",
    kpi(n_states, "States affected"), "\n)\n```\n", sep = "")
```

# Key messages

- **`r total` cases** and **`r deaths` deaths** (CFR `r sprintf("%.1f", cfr)`%) have been reported across **`r n_states` states**; `r conf` (`r round(conf/total*100)`%) are laboratory-confirmed.
- In the last 7 days (from `r format(last_wk, "%d %b")`), **`r cases_last7` new cases** were reported, `r if (change < 0) "a decrease" else "an increase"` of **`r abs(round(change))`%** on the previous 7 days (`r cases_prev7` cases).
- **`r top_state`** accounts for the largest share of cases (`r round(by_state$cases[1]/total*100)`%). **`r hi_cfr$state`** has the highest CFR (`r sprintf("%.1f", hi_cfr$cfr)`%), `r if (hi_cfr$cfr > 1) "above" else "within"` the 1% target.

# Epidemiological curve

```{r curve}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.2
#| fig-cap: "Cases by date of symptom onset, with 7-day moving average."
daily <- ll |> count(onset_date) |>
  complete(onset_date = seq(min(onset_date), max(onset_date), by = "day"), fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  mutate(ma7 = stats::filter(n, rep(1/7, 7), sides = 1) |> as.numeric())
ggplot(daily, aes(onset_date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n), fill = brand, alpha = 0.35, width = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ma7), colour = accent, linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 weeks", date_labels = "%d %b") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases")
```

# Geographic distribution

```{r state-table}
#| tbl-cap: "Cases, deaths and attack rate by state."
tab <- by_state |>
  transmute(State = state,
            Cases = cases, Confirmed = confirmed, Deaths = deaths,
            `CFR (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", cfr),
            `AR / 100,000` = sprintf("%.1f", ar))
tot <- tibble(State = "**Total**", Cases = total, Confirmed = conf, Deaths = deaths,
              `CFR (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", cfr),
              `AR / 100,000` = sprintf("%.1f", total / sum(pop$population) * 1e5))
knitr::kable(bind_rows(tab, tot), align = "lrrrrr")
```

```{r state-bar}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.4
#| fig-cap: "Attack rate per 100,000 population by state."
ggplot(by_state, aes(reorder(state, ar), ar)) +
  geom_col(fill = brand, width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", ar)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Attack rate per 100,000")
```

# Who is affected

```{r age-sex}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.5
#| fig-cap: "Cases by age group and sex."
ll |>
  mutate(age_grp = cut(age, c(-1, 4, 14, 29, 44, 59, Inf),
                       labels = c("0–4", "5–14", "15–29", "30–44", "45–59", "60+"))) |>
  count(age_grp, sex) |>
  ggplot(aes(age_grp, n, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Female = accent, Male = brand), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Age group (years)", y = "Cases")
```

```{r outcome}
#| tbl-cap: "Case outcomes."
knitr::kable(ll |> count(Outcome = outcome, name = "Cases") |>
  mutate(`%` = sprintf("%.1f", Cases / sum(Cases) * 100)), align = "lrr")
```

# Response and next steps

## Priority actions
- Intensify case management and ORS/IV fluid supply in **`r paste(unique(c(top_state, hi_cfr$state)), collapse = " and ")`**.
- Strengthen WASH interventions and community health education in affected LGAs.
- Improve confirmation: only `r round(conf/total*100)`% of cases are laboratory-confirmed.

## Gaps and challenges
- Delayed reporting from peripheral facilities.
- Limited stock of oral cholera vaccine for reactive campaigns.

::: {.callout-note}
*Edit this section by hand each week; everything above updates automatically from `data/linelist.csv`.*
:::

# Data sources and notes

Case data come from the national line list (suspected and confirmed cases by date of symptom onset). Attack rates use projected state populations. **All data in this sample are simulated and do not describe a real outbreak.**
